sources.label: Solana Token Program freeze authority documentation

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432913343, the live MOVEUSD mint lists 3AdhVEX6k85yNivHVXDEiY3WyP2WgFQTUZCahGaeC2qm as both its freezeAuthority and mintAuthority. Under the SPL Token Program, a current freeze authority can freeze individual token accounts, preventing transfers, burns, and delegate changes until thawed.
